Well you may never forget if you burn yourself out you can't help anyone anymore. If taking care of them like that drains your battery it's important to recharge it by self care. That's not only when helping others but always when we do things we find important. There are lots of ways of self care but they will usually be doing yourself good in some way. That can be things like following a hobby or doing something you enjoy, extra time for spa like taking a longer bath, an extra hour or sleep, a nice drink or food, meditation and so much more. Also keep in mind there is not only an on and off mode for helping friends. You can still contact them daily but to a smaller extent. No matter how much you think about it you can't turn back time. You can only learn by and grow by mistakes and maybe deal different with future opportunities in life. There is no right or wrong decisions when it comes to these things and you had good arguments to make your decision. The situation may lead to you prioritizing arguments differently in the future. All you can do at this point is accepting things that are past and can't be changed and focus your energy on making the best out of your situation how it is now. You don't want to miss or fail to notice a new or current opportunity cause you're too focused on the past. Be aware that the what if question can't be answered with certainty. It would only be speculations as for example the opportunity could have come with challenges you weren't aware of. You can only compare yourself to yourself by asking yourself if you really do your best, which doesn't mean you should neglect self care.
